## `~/` whoami

```console
$ cat about.txt
```

Hi, I'm **Mukesh Balamurugan** — a cybersecurity engineer from Tamil Nadu 🇮🇳,
learning & hardening since **2024**. I test systems, find the gaps and help close them —
from web applications and networks to the people using them.

- 🎯 Focus: **ethical hacking · vulnerability analysis · secure systems**
- 🎣 Built **[phishing_detector](https://github.com/mukesh-03-code/phishing_detector)** — ML scoring of suspicious URLs & emails (domain patterns, TLS, redirects)
- 🍯 Built **[honeypot](https://github.com/mukesh-03-code/honeypot)** — SSH/Telnet/HTTP decoy with credential harvesting & ATT&CK classification
- 🛠️ Tooling: **Burp Suite · Nmap · Kali Linux · Wireshark · Python**
- 🌐 Portfolio: **[mukesh-balamurugan.web.app](https://mukesh-balamurugan.web.app/)** · 📄 **[Résumé](https://pdfhost.io/v/yM33sjUWaH_Mukesh_B_Resume)**
